# MapleInstitutionalArk

## MapleInstitutionalArk
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/arks/MapleInstitutionalArk.sol)

**Inherits:**
[ArkWithWithdrawalRequest](../ark-with-withdrawal-request.md)

**Title:**
MapleInstitutionalArk

Ark contract for managing token supply and yield generation through Maple Finance Institutional pools

Implements strategy for direct depositing tokens via IERC4626 and managing withdrawals


### State Variables
#### vault
The Maple/Syrup pool (ERC4626-style vault) this Ark deposits into


```solidity
ISyrupPool public immutable vault
```


#### manager
The Maple/Syrup pool manager, used to resolve the withdrawal manager


```solidity
ISyrupManager public immutable manager
```


#### withdrawalManager
The Maple/Syrup withdrawal manager that escrows shares and processes redemptions


```solidity
ISyrupWithdrawalManagerV2 public immutable withdrawalManager
```


### Functions
#### constructor

Constructor to set up the MapleInstitutionalArk


```solidity
constructor(address _vault, ArkParams memory _params) ArkWithWithdrawalRequest(_params, 15);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_vault`|`address`|Address of the Maple Institutional pool|
|`_params`|`ArkParams`|ArkParams struct containing necessary parameters for Ark initialization|


#### totalAssets

Returns the total assets managed by this Ark


```solidity
function totalAssets() public view override(Ark, IArk) returns (uint256 assets);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`assets`|`uint256`|Sum of withdrawable assets, shares in Ark, and shares in withdrawal queue|


#### assetsInWithdrawalQueue

Returns the assets in the withdrawal queue.


```solidity
function assetsInWithdrawalQueue() public view returns (uint256);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|assets The amount of underlying assets currently pending withdrawal.|


#### requestWithdrawal

Request redemption of shares from the Maple pool

limited to single request at a time


```solidity
function requestWithdrawal(uint256 amount) external onlyKeeper;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|Amount of token to withdraw|


#### claimWithdrawal

Maple processes withdrawals automatically

This function is only callable by the keeper.


```solidity
function claimWithdrawal() external onlyKeeper;
```

#### isWithdrawalClaimRequired

Maple processes withdrawals automatically

It's a keeper helper method to check if a claim is required.


```solidity
function isWithdrawalClaimRequired() public view returns (bool);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|required Whether a withdrawal claim is required.|


#### withdrawalRequestId

Returns the current withdrawal request id.


```solidity
function withdrawalRequestId() external view returns (uint256);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|requestId The current withdrawal request id.|


#### cancelWithdrawal

Cancels the pending withdrawal request and returns shares to the Ark

Uses Maple's pool.removeShares to cancel the request


```solidity
function cancelWithdrawal() external onlyKeeper;
```

#### withdrawUsingSwap

Withdraws assets from the Ark using a swap

This function is only callable by the keeper


```solidity
function withdrawUsingSwap(uint256 amount, bytes calldata data) external onlyKeeper nonReentrant;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of assets to withdraw|
|`data`|`bytes`|The data to pass to the swap (router and swap calldata)|


#### _withdrawableTotalAssets

Returns the underlying asset balance held directly by the Ark.
Only includes tokens already processed by Maple's withdrawal manager
and sent back to the Ark — not shares or escrowed amounts.


```solidity
function _withdrawableTotalAssets() internal view override returns (uint256);
```

#### _board

Deposits the asset into the Maple pool, receiving pool shares


```solidity
function _board(uint256 amount, bytes calldata) internal override;
```

#### _disembark

No-op disembark hook; exits are asynchronous via requestWithdrawal through the withdrawal manager


```solidity
function _disembark(uint256, bytes calldata) internal override;
```

#### _harvest

No-op harvest: the Maple pool auto-accrues yield, so no rewards are claimed here


```solidity
function _harvest(bytes calldata)
    internal
    pure
    override
    returns (address[] memory rewardTokens, uint256[] memory rewardAmounts);
```

#### _validateBoardData

Validates the board data (no-op; this Ark requires no board data)


```solidity
function _validateBoardData(bytes calldata) internal override;
```

#### _validateDisembarkData

Validates the disembark data (no-op; this Ark requires no disembark data)


```solidity
function _validateDisembarkData(bytes calldata) internal override;
```

#### _assetsInWithdrawalQueue

Calculates the asset value of shares escrowed in Maple's withdrawal manager.
Uses the exit exchange rate (accounts for unrealizedLosses) to prevent
front-running of impairment events.


```solidity
function _assetsInWithdrawalQueue() internal view returns (uint256);
```

#### _withdrawalRequestId

Returns the last withdrawal request ID for this Ark from Maple's queue-based
withdrawal manager. Returns 0 if no pending request exists.


```solidity
function _withdrawalRequestId() internal view returns (uint256);
```



## InvalidWithdrawalManager
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/arks/MapleInstitutionalArk.sol)

Thrown when the Maple pool's manager reports a zero withdrawal manager address


```solidity
error InvalidWithdrawalManager();
```



## WrongAmountOfSharesReturned
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/arks/MapleInstitutionalArk.sol)

Thrown when cancelling a withdrawal returns a different share amount than was escrowed


```solidity
error WrongAmountOfSharesReturned();
```
